payout_quote: Our Refer-a-Friend program lets you and your friend both earn $75. ... 3. You both get $75! ... Referral payments will be processed within 32 days from the date of completion of all qualification requirements and will be deposited into the share savings account.
steps: Be an Empower FCU member in good standing (18+) and submit your friend's referral through the online form, a branch, or by calling 800.462.5000 BEFORE the new member's account is opened.
Your friend (not a current Empower FCU member) opens a share savings account and a checking account with a debit card within 60 days.
Your friend makes at least 10 debit or credit card purchases of $10+ each in the first 30 days after enrollment, and at least 10 more $10+ purchases in the 30 days that follow (20 total).
You both receive $75: referral payments are processed within 32 days of completion of all requirements and deposited into the share savings account.
catches: The $75 is deposited into your share savings account - not cash in hand - and takes up to 32 days after all requirements are completed.
The friend's purchase bar is high: 20 purchases of at least $10 each across two consecutive 30-day periods.
The referral must be submitted BEFORE the new member opens the account; retroactive credit is not possible.
Business accounts, HSA accounts, and rep payee accounts are ineligible; employees, volunteers, and their household family members are excluded.
Members must be in good standing to collect; promotion subject to change or cancellation without notice.
Share savings earns 0.55% APY - the deposit sits in savings.
biggest_catch: Your friend must make 20 separate $10+ card purchases across two consecutive months before either of you sees the $75 - and the referral form has to be in before they open the account.
eligibility: Empower FCU members 18+ in good standing. Referred friend must not be a current Empower FCU member and must be 18+ and membership-eligible.
timing: Referral payments processed within 32 days of completion of all qualification requirements; deposited into share savings.
